t: GPA Calculator to Calculate Semester and Cumulative GPA for Free
Free GPA calculator to accurately calculate your semester and cumulative GPA based on your courses and credit hours, with an estimate of the GPA needed to reach your academic goal quickly and easily.

Yes, this calculator lets you calculate your cumulative and semester GPA in seconds without complex spreadsheets or long manual calculations. It works entirely in your browser, respects your privacy, and does not send your data to any server. Enter each course name, its credit hours, and its grade out of 100, then choose a 4-point or 5-point grading scale, and the calculator will automatically convert your percentage grade to the appropriate grade points. Add your previously completed credit hours and cumulative GPA, then press the calculate button to get your new semester GPA and updated cumulative GPA after adding this semester's courses. You can also enter your target GPA and planned remaining credit hours to find out the GPA you need in upcoming courses to reach your academic goal, with a clear note if the goal is difficult or almost guaranteed. Remember to delete any course added by mistake and review each course's credit hours before calculating to get an accurate result that helps you plan for excellence and success.
How to Use the Calculator Easily and Accurately

Choose the GPA scale used by your university, whether 4-point or 5-point, then enter your previously completed credit hours and current cumulative GPA before this semester. Next, fill in this semester's course details, including credit hours and grades, and press the calculate button to see the result instantly with a clear explanation of the GPA needed to achieve your future goal.
Enter each course name, its credit hours, and its grade out of 100, then add another course if needed or delete a course by clicking the delete button next to it to easily correct your data.
Enter your data and press the calculate button to view advice.

Note: Percentage grades are automatically converted to grade points, and results may vary slightly depending on your university's system, so check your college's official grading system to ensure full accuracy.
How does the calculator compute the cumulative GPA?

It multiplies each course's grade points by its credit hours, adds them together, then divides by the total credit hours to get the semester GPA. It then combines previous semesters' points with this semester's points to accurately calculate the new cumulative GPA.
What is the difference between the 4-point and 5-point scales?

The 4-point scale is the most common in universities, while the 5-point scale is used by some institutions. Choose the scale adopted by your university, and the calculator will automatically convert your percentage grade to the appropriate points.
Are my data saved or sent to the server?
No, the tool runs entirely in your browser. No data is sent or saved to any server, and you can use it offline after the page loads.
What should I do if the required GPA is above the scale?

This means your goal is hard to achieve with the specified remaining hours. You can consider increasing the remaining hours, raising your current GPA first, or adjusting your goal to a more realistic value.
